title: Shai-Hulud self-replicating npm worm
attack_vector: Stolen npm tokens; a postinstall payload harvests secrets and republishes the victim maintainer's other packages
notes: Discovered by scanning OSV MAL-2025-46986..48599 for records whose references name the campaign. Many maintainers, so no single HAD_PUBLISH_RIGHTS edge; no curated clean versions.
Unlike the qix incident, most packages have several bad versions.
